rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded/thinned-zona blastocyst with weak/indistinct ICM and loose TE, consistent with 3BB; minor overinterpretation of debris/granularity from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, endometriosis, prior failed cycles, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately moderated by embryo grade and patient factors; slight uncertainty from broad probability estimates and some speculative uterine-factor discussion.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and lifestyle optimization; minor deviations include somewhat speculative ancillary testing and broad comments on PGT-A.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, smoking cessation, weight optimization, luteal support review, and uterine/endometriosis reassessment.
